{{Quote|Although the Clone Wars were over, some people never seemed to get the message.|Retired clone trooper|<ref name="BFII">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>}}
The '''Reconquest of the Rim''' was the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] series of campaigns to pacify the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] after the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and the [[Declaration of a New Order]]. The successful operations against [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|holdouts]], [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], and [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]], which lasted from [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] to [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]], were a great victory for the Empire, both physical and psychological; the Outer Rim was secured, and the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] won widespread support for finally crushing lawlessness in the region.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Billions of beings now look forward to a secure future. The Empire will grow as more planets feel the call, from the Rim to the wilds of unknown space.|Emperor Palpatine|<ref name="Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241">{{InsiderCite|84|Republic HoloNet News Special Inaugural Edition 16:5:241}}</ref>}}
The [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] brought the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] to the previously neglected [[Rim]], pushing back the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Hutt Space/Legends|sphere of influence]] and controlling the far-flung worlds of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] by means of military occupation. The [[Tion Cluster/Legends|Tion Cluster]] was home to the civilian [[Separatist Senate/Legends|Separatist government]], and the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] had pledged allegiance to the Confederacy, bringing the front lines of the war to the Outer Rim. The [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]] ended with victory for the new Empire, but the Rim was not yet fully under Imperial control.<ref name="EGtW" />

For a month, the [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] of Nar Shaddaa celebrated the end of the war in clubs and [[Cantina/Legends|cantinas]], not for the same reasons many in the central regions welcomed the new Empire, but because they believed that the Emperor would focus on consolidating power in the Core, leaving worlds in the Mid and Outer Rims to their own devices. Nar Shaddaans hoped that this would give [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]] freedom to work the space lanes after having to sidestep the Republic and Separatist armies for three years, and the market for spice and other proscribed goods could once again open up.<ref name="Falcon">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>

==The reconquest==
===The campaigns of 19 BBY===
The large-scale mobilization of forces that marked the last phase of the Clone Wars was not halted with the creation of the Empire. [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], determined to unite the entire galaxy under his rule, deployed his armies in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid]] and Outer Rims to eradicate Separatist holdouts and the forces of lawlessness that had plagued the outlying regions in the last years of the Republic. The three main fronts of the Reconquest of the Rim in 19 BBY were the [[Ciutric Hegemony|Ciutric sector]], the former [[Foundry of the Confederacy/Legends|Foundry of the Confederacy]] and the [[Five Veils Route/Legends|Five Veils Route]].<ref name="EGtW" />

====The Ciutric Offensive====
{{Main|Ciutric Offensive}}
[[File:Hurst_Romodi.jpg|thumb|left|250px|General [[Hurst Romodi/Legends|Hurst Romodi]] leading from the open hatch of a [[HAVr A9 Floating Fortress/Legends|Floating Fortress]].]]
After the massacre of the [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist leadership]] by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], Confederate forces driven from [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] and [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]] retreated across the [[Void of Chopani/Legends|Void of Chopani]] and established a power base in the [[Ciutric sector/Legends|Ciutric sector]]. Funding came from shadowy interests on [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] and [[Celanon/Legends|Celanon]], and military support from [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Thalassian/Legends|Thalassian]] [[Thalassian slavers/Legends|slavers]] who joined their cause as privateers. The [[Tenth Army|10th Sector Army]] mobilized from [[Axxila/Legends|Axxila]] to crush this new threat to Imperial dominance, with [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Terrinald Screed/Legends|Screed]] in command of the naval forces and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Hurst Romodi/Legends|Romodi]] in command of the ground forces.<ref name="EGtW" />

The [[Battle of Vinsoth (Imperial Period)|Battle of Vinsoth]] was a victory for the Empire and for Screed, forcing the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] leadership of the Ciutric Separatists to flee to [[Binquaros]], where they dug in for a siege. While General Romodi led his forces against the Muuns, Admiral Screed pursued the holdouts' ships to [[Bimmiel/Legends|Bimmiel]]. The Imperial forces won a victory with overwhelming losses for the other side in the [[Battle of Bimmiel]], but the [[Siege of Binquaros|Battle of Binquaros]] did not end well for the Empire. A coalition of pirates and [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] driven off the [[Salin Corridor/Legends|Salin Corridor]] by the Imperial military in engagements at [[Engagement at Fenion|Fenion]], [[Engagement at Phindar|Phindar]] and [[Engagement at Sheris|Sheris]] joined forces with Serennian [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and broke the siege of Binquaros. The Separatists fled Binquaros and headed for the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. Before they could find a safe haven, they were betrayed by a pirate captain and crushed by Screed and Romodi at [[Vardoss system/Legends|Vardoss]]. The [[Assault on Vardoss IV]] ended the Ciutric Offensive, and the Empire secured the region.<ref name="EGtW" />

====The Sy Myrthian Insurrection====
{{Main|Sy Myrthian Insurrection}}
Out of the former [[Foundry of the Confederacy/Legends|Foundry of the Confederacy]], ravaged by the Republic during the Outer Rim Sieges, emerged a new threat to the Empire in the form of [[Toonbuck Toora/Legends|Toonbuck Toora]],<ref name="EGtW" /> the former [[Senator/Legends|senator]] of [[Sy Myrth/Legends|Sy Myrth]] who had led her world in secession from the Republic during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]].<ref name="HNN45">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|45|news/13228_1.html|Ando, Sy Myrth Secede}}</ref> Toora reactivated factory worlds and rallied ground and naval forces in preparation for a war with the new Empire, which came when the [[Twelfth Army/Legends|12th Sector Army]] relocated to [[Charros IV/Legends|Charros]]. Under Admiral [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]] and General [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]], they engaged Toora's forces in a series of protracted conflicts, among which were the [[Battle of Metalorn (Imperial Period)|Battles of Metalorn]] and [[Battle of Diado|Diado]].<ref name="EGtW" />

After several months of fighting, Imperial forces under General Dodonna besieged Sy Myrth and forced Toora to flee. Dodonna led the chase against Toora on the [[Battlecruiser/Legends|Battlecruiser]] [[Battalion (Praetor-class)|''Battalion'']], capturing her in the [[Trasemene system/Legends|Trasemene system]]. In the [[Battle of Trasemene]], Toora's flagship, the ''[[Defiance's Banner]]'', was destroyed, and the Sy Myrthian Insurrection ended. Some holdout forces escaped to the [[Kreetan Narrows]] and continued low-level resistance, which ultimately led to the Empire claiming the area from the Hutts.<ref name="EGtW" />

====The Five Veils Campaign====
{{Main|Five Veils Campaign}}
Following the death of [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] on Mustafar and the conquest of [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]] and the [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] [[Purse world/Legends|purse worlds]], [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Acting Viceroy]] of the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Sentepeth Findos]] signed a [[Imperial–Trade Federation treaty|treaty]] with the Empire, surrendering the cartel's resources to Imperial control and effectively dissolving the Trade Federation. However, [[Customs Vizier]] [[Marath Vooro]] refused to acknowledge Findos' authority or the treaty and retained control of Trade Federation ships and droids at [[Enarc/Legends|Enarc]], establishing an enclave of Separatist space around the [[Five Veils Route/Legends|Five Veils Route]].<ref name="EGtW" />

Vooro's resistance bolstered the morale of the remaining Separatists, but he had a critical lack of effective commanders. An Imperial fleet under the command of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Octavian Grant]] decisively defeated Vooro's forces at the [[Battle of Farstine]], then pursued him down the Five Veils Route, ultimately capturing Vooro at the [[Hook Nebula/Legends|Hook Nebula]].<ref name="EGtW" />

===The campaigns of 18 BBY===
====The Listehol Campaign====
{{Main|Listehol Campaign}}
The Listehol campaign saw operations against the [[Sikurdian/Legends|Sikurdian]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] and [[Tervig]] [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]] at the northern end of the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]]. The criminal groups had launched numerous raids against the [[Shaltin Tunnels/Legends|Shaltin Tunnels]] and the [[Listehol Run/Legends|Listehol Run]] and were pushing in to the newly-reorganized [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]]. Imperial forces under the command of [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] and [[Bannidge Holt]] defeated the Sikurdians at the [[Battle of Sagma]], before pacifying [[Sikurd]] and advancing down the Listehol Run to interdict [[Zygerria/Legends|Zygerria]]. Yularen then pushed down the Shaltin Tunnels to raid [[Tervissis]]. The planet would resist Imperial raids until it was finally occupied by the Empire in [[13 BBY/Legends|13 BBY]].<ref name="EGtW" />

====The Noolian Crisis====
{{Main|Noolian Crisis}}
Fought in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], the Noolian Crisis began after the Separatist world of [[Ando/Legends|Ando]] surrendered to the Empire. [[Aqualish/Legends|Aqualish]] and [[Harch/Legends|Harch]] forces fleeing the defeat harried Imperial forces in the southern [[The Slice/Legends|Slice]], launching hit-and-run attacks out of [[Leritor/Legends|Leritor]] on medical and logistics facilities. The Aqualish successfully took [[Nooli]], [[Galboron]] and even pushed into [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan Space]] before being defeated at the [[Battle of Galboron]] by Imperial forces led by Captain [[Par Lankin]].<ref name="EGtW" />

===The campaigns of 17 BBY===
====The Western Reaches Operation====
{{Main|Western Reaches Operation}}
The Western Reaches Operation was the largest campaign of the Reconquest of the Rim. After the [[Battle of Bomis Koori IV|fall]] of [[Bomis Koori IV]] in the [[Outer Rim Sieges/Legends|Outer Rim Sieges]], Separatist forces had fled Rimward down the [[Corellian Trade Spine/Legends|Corellian Trade Spine]], seeking shelter amid the pirate bases and slavers' nests of the lawless [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]]. Emperor Palpatine was determined to pacify the region, and Moff [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]] of Eriadu was given command of the operation.<ref name="EGtW" />

The campaign was heavily resourced, with Terrinald Screed and Bannidge Holt taking command of naval operations while Hurst Romodi was charged with ground operations. Advancing from [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]], Screed and Holt's forces defeated the Separatists at the [[Battle of Kelrodo-Ai]] and won a further victory at [[Battle of Pendaxa|Pendaxa]]. Further north, Imperial forces moved up the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]] and defeated the Separatists at the [[Battle of Ord Vaug]], before swinging back south down the Corellian Trade Spine and winning victories at [[Battle of Halm|Halm]], [[Battle of Ichtor|Ichtor]] and [[Battle of the Feather Nebula|the Feather Nebula]].<ref name="EGtW" />

In the south at [[Bryndar]], Holt was killed and Romodi badly injured in an ambush by the [[Iska pirates/Legends|Iska pirates]]. Screed and the Imperial TIE ace [[Shea Hublin]] smashed the Iska pirates at [[Fanha/Legends|Fanha]], forcing the pirate lord [[Guun Cutlax]] to flee into the [[Atravis sector/Legends|Atravis sector]], where he linked up with Separatist forces under the command of General [[Kendu Ultho]]. In pursuit, Screed and Hublin defeated Cutlax at the [[Battle of Tosste/Legends|Battle of Tosste]] before concluding the campaign with the defeat of Ultho at the [[Battle of Ogoth Tiir/Legends|Battle of Ogoth Tiir]].<ref name="EGtW" />

==Aftermath==
The Reconquest of the Rim was heavily propagandised by the Empire, and in later years Imperial citizens were said to always remember where they had been when they heard of Holt's death and Romodi's injury at Bryndar. Various [[Holodrama/Legends|holodramas]] were made of the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military's]] exploits in the Rim. Many Imperials would later look back on this era nostalgically, remembering it as a time when the young Empire restored peace and order to the Outer Rim.<ref name="EGtW" /> Subsequently, the Empire made a number of [[Outer Rim reconciliation efforts|conciliatory measures]] to politically reconcile the Outer Rim to Imperial rule.<ref name="Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut|series=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|text=Part 8: Tales of the Clone Wars}}</ref>

The campaigns boosted the profile of many of the Imperial officers involved: [[Wullf Yularen/Legends|Wullf Yularen]] and [[Hurst Romodi/Legends|Hurst Romodi]] later entered prominent command positions aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|First Death Star]] under the command of [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]]. [[Octavian Grant]] would become one of the first of the twelve [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admirals]] of the New Order. For others, it was the peak of their careers: [[Terrinald Screed/Legends|Terrinald Screed]] sank into obscurity after the Western Reaches Operation and ended up leading corrupt business and slaving schemes in the Outer Rim with [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Bisad Koong]] of [[Roon/Legends|Roon]].

==Behind the scenes==
Although the events within were frequently referred to in various sources, it wasn't until the release of ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' that the overall time period (19 BBY&ndash;17 BBY) was actually given a name. According to one of the sourcebook's two authors, [[Jason Fry]], this section was one of his favorites.<ref name="JFT">{{Tumblr|subdomain=jasonfry|url=post/23039847571/eg-to-warfare-endnotes-pt-7|name=Jason Fry's Dorkery|text=EG to Warfare: Endnotes Pt. 7}}</ref>
